content.text: Insurance exists (WC, CGL 1M, E&O 1M, certificates) but there's no cyber/privacy coverage, and the Contractor handles Company data and accesses Company systems. Let me validate a minimal redline.

input.summary: Add cyber/privacy liability coverage to the existing insurance covenant, since Contractor handles Company data and accesses Company systems.
input.comment: [Playbook] The insurance covenant covers workers' compensation, general liability and E&O but omits cyber/privacy coverage, and Contractor accesses our systems and handles our data and Confidential Information. We have added cyber liability insurance of USD 5,000,000 per our playbook; we can accept USD 2,000,000 if that better matches your current program.

ops.oldText: coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor
ops.newText: coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), and, where Contractor accesses, stores or otherwise processes Company data or Confidential Information, cyber liability (including network security and privacy) insurance with coverage of at least five million dollars ($5,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor
